annotations.title: Chart of accounts of a DIYA-GL book

description: Answers the chart of accounts of the open DIYA-GL book: each account's id, name, group, class and normal side, for a company the accounts line it feeds, the spreadsheet column it lands in, how many lines post to it with their total in pence, and the report rows it reaches. Use this when the person asks which account to use for something, where a cost shows in their accounts, or which accounts have no activity. It does not change the book.
